rv.q: Audiences looking for something less bombastic will adore this warm hug of a show.
What a wonderful, sincere telling of this classic story with the exceptionally talented cast I have come to expect from this theater.

With a soaring score and poignant lyrics, Little Women captures the hope, love, and personal sacrifice that shape the March sisters’ journey, reminding us all that no dream is too big when you have the support of those you love.
